faq.a: YES! Tropical Treats is located towards the back of the park. They offer a variety of options from refreshing lemonade to sweet treats such as funnel cakes.

faq.q: What is the shoe policy and clothing restrictions?
faq.a: All shoes must stay secured on all feet to drive. No loose clothing will be permitted and all long hair must be tied up in a bun off the shoulders. Closed toe shoes are recommended.

faq.q: How tall does my child need to be to ride the go karts?
faq.a: Motor World offers go kart tracks for children as small as 36". They must be at least 48" tall to start to drive the bigger go karts by themselves.

faq.q: What is included with the wristband?
faq.a: Pro Band will include all go kart rides that the person meets the height requirement for. Rookie bands include all small amusement rides and go kart tracks that the person meets the height requirement for. All Unlimited Armbands do not include Adult Speed Track.

faq.q: Do I have to pay if I am not riding?
faq.a: Admission into the park is free and you only pay for the activities you want to do. Pricing is based per person.

faq.q: What is the difference between a Rookie Band and Pro Band?
faq.a: Rookie Band: Under 48" tall. Pro Band: Over 48" tall.

faq.q: What are the hours of operation?
faq.a: March - Memorial Day: 10 am - Dark. Memorial Day - Labor Day: 10 am - 10 pm. After Labor Day: 10 am - Dark. Please visit our calendar for hours or call our office at 757-422-6419.

faq.q: Do you have parking and is it free?
faq.a: Yes, all parking for cars and buses is free.

Go-karts can still operate in the rain. Three tracks will typically close when it rains: slick 8, outlaw, and the adult speed track. During inclement weather Motor World reserves the right to close for the day. We will gladly reschedule for another date or a deposit refund will be issued for the inconvenience.
Motor World is located at 700 S. Birdneck Rd. Virginia Beach, about 2.5 miles south of the oceanfront.

faq.q: Is there an age requirement for the Adult Speed Track?
faq.a: Must be 16 years of age or older to drive. Riders under the age of 18 must have a parent/guardian present in order to sign the waiver. All racers must sign a liability waiver.
